players.product: Optical monitors used in optical transceivers, optical filters and attenuators; optical test instruments for optical communications (tunable light sources, optical power meters, connectorized fiber-cable inspection systems)

quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April - September 2025): net sales rose 6.5% on strong sales of optical monitors and of connectorized optical fiber cable inspection systems among optical communications instruments; ordinary profit rose on smaller foreign-exchange losses. Half-year R&D expense was JPY 1,070 million
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 12,778 million (+6.5%); operating profit JPY 4,119 million (+6.6%); ordinary profit JPY 4,249 million (+9.0%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 3,058 million (+14.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: Optical components segment, first half of FY ending March 2026: demand recovered sharply from the prior year's inventory-adjustment period, with optical monitor sales especially strong
quarterly_data.figure: Segment sales JPY 2,712 million (+78.5%); segment profit JPY 698 million (+584.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: Optical instruments segment, first half of FY ending March 2026: optical communications instruments sold strongly overall, as demand for connectorized optical fiber cable inspection systems was firm especially in North America while sales in China fell in reaction to the prior year's special demand for optical-characteristics inspection systems; industrial instruments were weak as sales of semiconductor silicon-wafer inspection systems fell on global silicon-wafer inventory adjustment; medical sales of the ARGOS optical biometer, mainly in the US, were flat year on year. MOG Laboratories, acquired July 1, 2025, is consolidated in industrial instruments from Q2
quarterly_data.figure: Segment sales JPY 9,295 million (-3.6%); segment profit JPY 3,370 million (-9.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (H1 FY2026 report): it expects demand for optical components to be stronger than the prior year as customers' inventory adjustment has run its course; for optical communications instruments it expects data-center capex to stay firm and inquiries from optical transmission equipment makers in Japan and overseas to remain solid; for industrial instruments it expects demand to settle as silicon-wafer manufacturing capex pauses, while demand for industrial-measurement and medical light sources stays solid; medical instrument demand is expected to remain stable

Total assets rose mainly on higher inventories, including raw materials, to prepare for upcoming production and shipments, higher land and construction in progress from acquiring a new factory in Canada, and goodwill from the MOG Laboratories acquisition
quarterly_data.figure: Total assets JPY 31,974 million (from JPY 29,527 million)
